name: Frequency meter
summary: A frequency meter indicates the frequency of its measured input.
description: A frequency meter indicates the frequency of its measured input. The source of that input must be clear when multiple buses or generators are present.
readingNotes: Trace the measurement to the correct bus or VT circuit.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A frequency meter displays a quantity; an underfrequency relay applies an operating threshold.
